sites.howToIntro: From the site's backend (never from the browser — that's what keeps the key out of sight):

guide.title: How to connect a site
guide.intro: Four steps. Your site's form posts to your own server, and your server forwards it here with the site's key.

create.title: Create the site here and copy the key
create.body: Use the form above. The key is shown once: save it the moment you see it. If you lose it, issue another key and revoke the old one once the site is sending with the new one.

env.title: Store the key in the site's environment
env.body: As VENDERCRM_API_KEY in the .env file or in the hosting environment variables. Never in the HTML, in browser JavaScript, or in the repository.

handler.title: Paste the handler on your server
handler.body: Pick your stack below and copy the code. The form points at your own endpoint, and that endpoint is what calls clientes.com.py.

verify.title: Test it with a real submission
verify.body: Fill in the form with your own number. Within seconds the contact appears and, if you set a target stage, so does the deal in the pipeline. If it doesn't, check your server log: the response says why.

security.serverSide: The key lives on the site's server. Put it in the browser and anyone can read it and write into your pipeline.
security.idempotency: Always send idempotency_key. With the same key, a retry or a double click doesn't create a duplicate contact.
security.phone: The phone number is required and is the contact's identity. We accept the Paraguayan local format (0981 123 456) and normalise it to +595.
security.spam: Add the honeypot and, if you can, Cloudflare Turnstile. Spam is stopped at your site, not inside the CRM.
security.nonBlocking: If clientes.com.py doesn't answer, still show the visitor the thank-you page and record the error in your log. Never lose a lead to a timeout.

hookGuide.title: Connect a customer's site (without touching their server)
hookGuide.intro: For Elementor, Wix, Webflow, Zapier or Make. The customer doesn't have to install anything or give you access to their hosting: you issue the webhook URL on the site above, they paste it into their form, and that's it.
hookGuide.captureBody: As soon as the URL is in place, ask for a test submission from the customer's form. We store that submission exactly as it arrived, and then you pick from a list which field is the phone number, which is the name and which is the message. Until you do, submissions are stored as tests and don't enter the pipeline.
hookGuide.urlNote: The webhook URL is secret: anyone holding it can push leads into that site. Send it over a private channel, and revoke it from here if it leaks.

platforms.label: Elementor
steps: Open the page with the form and start editing it in Elementor.
Select the form widget and go to «Actions After Submit».
Add the «Webhook» action.
Paste the webhook URL into the «Webhook URL» field and save the page.
Send a test submission from the published page, not from the editor.

platforms.label: Wix
steps: In the Wix dashboard go to «Automations» and create a new automation.
Choose «Form is submitted» as the trigger and select the site's form.
Choose «Send an HTTP request» (or «Webhook») as the action.
Method POST, paste the webhook URL and leave the body with the form's data.
Turn the automation on and send a test submission from the published site.

platforms.label: Zapier / Make
steps: Create a Zap (or a Make scenario) with the customer's form as the trigger.
Add the «Webhooks by Zapier» → «POST» step (in Make: HTTP module → «Make a request»).
Paste the webhook URL and choose JSON as the body format.
Map the form fields into the body as they come; no renaming needed, you pick which is which here afterwards.
Turn the Zap on and run a test.

platforms.label: Other / manual
steps: Any tool that can send a POST will do: Webflow Logic, Formidable, Contact Form 7 with a webhook plugin, or the site's own backend.
POST to the webhook URL with the form contents as JSON (we also accept form-data submissions).
No special header or separate key is needed: the URL is the credential.
Send a test submission and come back here to pick the fields.

meta.title: More customers for your company | clientes.com.py
meta.description: We help established Paraguayan companies win more customers with an orderly sales process: lead capture, follow-up and measurement.

hero.title: More customers. An orderly sales process.
hero.lead: We help established Paraguayan companies win more customers — with a system, not with luck.
hero.body: If you already have a product that works and customers who come back, the ceiling is almost never demand. It's that lead capture depends on whoever has time that week.
points: An enquiry channel that doesn't shut down when the team is busy
Follow-up that happens either way, whoever is on shift
Clear numbers: how many enquiries came in and how many closed
hero.asideBody: A 30-minute diagnostic conversation. We look at where your customers come from today, what gets lost along the way, and what can be put in order first.
hero.asideNote: Free and with no commitment. If we can't see how to help you, we'll say so on the same call.

problem.title: You're not short of customers. You're short of a process.
problem.body: Most of the companies we work with have no product or market problem. They have enquiries arriving through five different places, quotes that never get an answer, and no way to know what worked last month.
problem.bodyTwo: That isn't fixed with more advertising. It's fixed by putting what already comes in in order, and adding lead capture on top of a base that holds.
problem.symptomsTitle: You can see it in concrete things
symptoms: Enquiries arriving on WhatsApp, by phone, on Instagram and through the form, with no single list
Quotes that were sent and never touched again
Salespeople starting each month from zero, not knowing who to pick back up
Good months and bad months with no clear explanation why

services.title: What we do
services.lead: It all points at the same thing: enquiries come in, and you can handle them. We choose the channels during the diagnostic, not before.

items.name: Google Ads
items.body: Show up exactly when someone searches for what you sell. Search, Performance Max and remarketing.

items.name: Meta Ads
items.body: Facebook and Instagram campaigns aimed at people who buy, not people who scroll. Creative, targeting and weekly optimisation.

items.name: SEO
items.body: Local and national rankings, so people find you without paying for every click.

items.name: Websites
items.body: Fast pages, built for mobile and for converting into WhatsApp. Not digital brochures.

items.name: Social media and content
items.body: A presence that supports the sale: content with intent and a calendar that is actually kept, not posting for the sake of it.

items.name: AI automation
items.body: An immediate answer to every enquiry and automatic WhatsApp follow-up, so nothing depends on who has time that afternoon.

services.fineprint: You pay the ad spend yourself, directly to Google or Meta. It never goes through us, and you always see what it was spent on.

method.title: Four stages, in this order
method.lead: We don't start with advertising. We start by understanding where your customers come from today and what is being lost.

steps.title: Diagnostic
steps.body: We look at your current channels, your sales cycle, and what happens to an enquiry from the moment it arrives until it closes.

steps.title: Lead capture
steps.body: We put the presence and the entry points in order so an interested person can contact you without friction.

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.body: Every enquiry is recorded and assigned, with reminders of its own. Nothing depends on anyone's memory.

steps.title: Measurement
steps.body: How many enquiries came in, from where, how many closed. That's what decides what to repeat next month.

verticals.title: Sectors where the method is already proven
verticals.lead: Companies with a validated offer and their own team, where growth gets stuck in capture and follow-up, not in the product.

items.name: Clinics and practices
items.body: Patients who ask on WhatsApp after hours, and appointments lost because nobody answered in time.

items.name: Construction companies
items.body: Projects and quotes with long cycles, where follow-up decides who ends up signing.

items.name: Real estate agencies
items.body: Enquiries and viewings arriving from several portals and ending up with no owner and no record.

items.name: Professional services
items.body: Firms and consultancies that grow by referral and want a second channel that doesn't depend on it.

items.name: B2B companies
items.body: Sales with several people deciding, where losing the thread costs months.

statement.text: A system that doesn't depend on who's on shift.
statement.sub: That's what separates a good month from a good year.

closing.title: Let's start with the diagnostic
closing.body: Half an hour, free. You leave with a clear picture of where work is being lost, whether you work with us or not.

meta.title: Our method for winning more customers | clientes.com.py
meta.description: Diagnostic, lead capture, follow-up and measurement: the four stages we use to put customer acquisition in order at Paraguayan companies.

header.title: How we work
header.lead: A fixed order, four stages, and one rule: we don't add lead capture on top of a process that is still losing enquiries.
header.body: What follows is literally what we do, in the order we do it. No stage is optional: each one exists because the next doesn't work without it.

items.title: Diagnostic
items.body: We look at where your customers come from today, how long your sales cycle takes, and what happens to an enquiry from arrival to close or loss. There is almost always a leak nobody was watching.
points: A map of current channels and the real volume of enquiries
The full journey of an enquiry, point by point
Where work is being lost today, with concrete examples

items.title: Lead capture
items.lead: Whoever wants to contact you, can.
items.body: We put the presence and entry points in order: the page, the form, the WhatsApp number, the Google listing. The goal isn't more traffic, it's that the interested person who already exists doesn't fall through.
points: Clear points of contact and one way in
Forms that land in a list, not in a stray inbox
WhatsApp as an entry channel, with a record of what comes in

items.title: Follow-up
items.body: Every enquiry is recorded, with an owner and a next action. Quotes that were sent come back up on their own when it's time. This is where most of the work being lost today is recovered.
points: One single list of enquiries, each with an owner
Follow-up reminders that appear without anyone entering them
A history of every conversation, available to the whole team

items.title: Measurement
items.body: How many enquiries came in, through which channel, how many converted and how long they took. That's what decides what gets repeated next month and what gets cut.
points: Enquiries by channel and by month
Close rate and average cycle time
A regular review with decisions, not just reports

included.title: What's left running
included.lead: The work ends when your team can keep it going without us standing over them.

items.title: The platform
items.body: It includes the platform where your team sees every enquiry and every follow-up. It's ours, it's called clientes.com.py, and it isn't software you have to go and buy separately.

items.title: The written process
items.body: Who handles what, how fast an answer goes out, and when a quote gets picked back up. Short and usable, not a manual nobody opens.

items.title: The trained team
items.body: We stay with the people who sell until the process runs by itself. A tool nobody uses has changed nothing.

statement.sub: The tools come afterwards, and they're whichever ones are needed.

items.a: Orderly follow-up usually shows something within the first few weeks, because it recovers enquiries you already had. New lead capture takes longer and depends on your sector's sales cycle.

items.q: Do you work with companies that are just starting?
items.a: No. We work with companies that already have customers, a team and an offer that works. If you're still validating what to sell, we're not the right partner and we'll tell you so.

items.q: Do we have to change the tools we already use?
items.a: Only what needs changing. If something already works, it stays. What can't stay is an enquiry going unrecorded.
It depends on the scope, and it comes out of the diagnostic. We'd rather give you a number we can stand behind than a price list that looks nothing like your case.

meta.title: Who we are | clientes.com.py
meta.description: A team focused on the commercial growth of established Paraguayan companies: why Paraguay, why these sectors, and how we work.

header.title: Who's behind this
header.lead: We're a small team working with established Paraguayan companies, at the point where growth stops being a matter of effort and becomes a matter of process.

story.title: Why Paraguay and why these sectors
story.body: Paraguay has a great many solid companies — clinics with years behind them, construction firms with steady work, practices with their own client base — that grew through referrals and good work. That growth works until it stops scaling.
story.bodyTwo: The next jump is almost never a campaign. It's stopping the loss of enquiries and being able to repeat what already works. That is exactly what we do, and it's why we work with companies that already have something, not with projects that are just starting.
story.bodyThree: We build what we use, first: the platform your team follows each enquiry in is developed by us. When something doesn't work, there's nobody to pass you on to.

principles.title: Three things we don't negotiate
principles.lead: This isn't a list of values for the wall. They're the three rules that have cost us money to hold to most often.

items.title: We say no
items.body: If the diagnostic shows we can't move the needle, we tell you right there. A badly taken client costs more than it brings in.

items.title: Numbers before opinions
items.body: Everything we propose has to be measurable. If it can't be measured, it's an idea, not a recommendation.

items.title: It has to keep working without us
items.body: The goal is for your team to keep the process going on its own. A permanent dependency would be comfortable for us and bad for you.

statement.text: We work with few companies at a time.
statement.sub: It's the only way to get properly inside each one's business.
